summary: Top Wealth Group Holding Ltd filed a 6-K reporting the results of its Extraordinary General Meeting held September 15, 2026 in Hong Kong, the US-equivalent of an EGM results announcement. As of the record date, 49,334,485 Class A and 3,166,667 Class B ordinary shares were entitled to vote; holders of roughly 83.7% of outstanding shares were represented. Shareholders approved Proposal One, adopting the Fourth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association for housekeeping amendments, and Proposal Two, authorizing adjournment for additional proxy solicitation. Both passed with 100.0% support. No special-situation transaction, no deal terms, no advisor named.
